kind: Signed browser release evidence and recovery of completed check/release receipts
qualification_scope: Assisted same-host signed-file browser exchange and completed-operation response loss with current implemented-core regressions; full onboarding, worker-crash recovery and production are open.

environment.postgresql: real retained task PostgreSQL 16.15 and task-owned disposable integration databases
environment.frontend: Exact React 19.3.1, TypeScript 7.0.2 and esbuild 0.28.2 lock; no new dependency versions.
environment.assistance: Autonomous implementation/test driving with synthetic data, identities and keys; no independent ordinary operator or downstream business consumer.
environment.resources: Serial gates; each Go process uses GOMAXPROCS=1, fuzz commands retain their stated one/two workers, Node soft heap 192 MiB. No global CPU/RSS cap claimed. Native GnuPG child-family watchdog 128 MiB/100 ms; observer memory is separate. Local inference and malware engine/standard database remain off.

first_failures.first_failure: Passing signed check omitted verified primary/signing fingerprints in the browser; required signer review locator timed out.
first_failures.resolution: Typed reference-bound recorded signer proof appears in both check detail and frozen release review.

first_failures.first_failure: New decoder rejected real pending report {} with empty report digest; intake controls disappeared.
first_failures.resolution: Normalize only the empty pre-check representation; signed completed states still require a complete exact proof. Seven frontend contracts cover this and malformed/mismatched graph/time fields.

first_failures.first_failure: After a real committed check response was dropped, browser retry generated another operation key and received HTTP 409.
first_failures.resolution: Scope/revision/source/policy/report derive stable command identity. Native check and release retries now recover original receipts; the check consumes one attempt.

qualification_harness_observations.summary: Playwright route.fetch rejected the fixture certificate in its separate trust store. Fault requests now use stock curl with exact fixture CA, hostname verification, protected headers, no redirects and unchanged server/browser TLS checks.
qualification_harness_observations.raw_trace_sensitivity: Original private trace can contain synthetic cookie/CSRF values; retained under ignored protected evidence, never copied into Git.

qualification_harness_observations.summary: Harness omitted the replay flag from its observation despite actual HTTP 200 and equal keys. Observation now records the real response field; the original replay assertion remains unchanged.

signed_browser.signature_profile: Independent v4 Ed25519 primary/signing subkey, SHA-256, armored detached signature, 100000 CSV data rows and 2700019 exact source bytes.

implementation: Decode bounded recorded proof joined to exact file/policy/attached object/signature digest/key reference; backend cryptographic verification and live authorization remain decisive.

Show full primary/signing fingerprints, registered key version/hash, signature digest/format and verification times in check detail and exact release review. Display CSV counts only for a valid CSV report.
Stable check/release command identities preserve meaning after lost acknowledgments. A later observed revision gets a different operation identity; keys grant no authority.

Unconfirmed release keeps its frozen review and explicit receipt retry. Definitive refusals require cancel/refresh/new review; in-flight review cannot be dismissed as if the operation had been canceled.
Malformed/oversized signature input receives actionable feedback while preserving attempt budget. Current signer revocation disables release and returns a readable native download refusal.

ci.new_gates: Frontend evidence contract and signed-browser profile are included in the existing foundation command invoked by core CI.

govulncheck.assessment: Existing module-only GO-2026-5932 concerns legacy x/crypto/OpenPGP outside imported packages; no release/image or complete security qualification implied.

npm_audit.scope: Full exact current production/development dependency lock.

gitleaks.scope: Unchanged default rules on this exact intermediate source/doc snapshot and 19 reachable commits. Final evidence metadata and new commit are rescanned in private verification.

limits: All 83 baseline rows and 12 complete product journeys remain open. Assisted same-host driving does not establish independent adoption, enterprise readiness, native Linux/Windows behavior or production safety.
Only completed check/release response loss is covered by this recovery exercise. Worker/process death before completion, expired-lease UI recovery and governed re-scan/rebind remain required.
Independent browser crypto profile here is v4 Ed25519/SHA-256. V6/SHA3 frontend shapes are unit contract coverage only; wider native crypto/peer/platform qualification remains open.
Explicit fixture certificate/SPKI and stock-curl fixture CA preserve TLS validation. Cookie/CSRF/header fixtures and raw sensitive traces stay private and ignored; no global trust-store changes.
First-admin/partner onboarding, invitations/providers, self-service key overlap, delegated review, sharing/batches/forms, complete accessibility and ordinary operator adoption remain open.

Actual malware detection/private signing/decryption custody, downstream business receipt, retention/reconstruction, HA/restore, performance/endurance and disconnected release/image security remain open. X05/X06 are pending; no model or scanner engine/database was loaded.
D043 intermittent custody fuzz deadline remains unassigned despite the unchanged current gate passing. GitHub execution remains unverified and nothing was pushed or externally deployed.
